topic.title: Forgot Your Password
topic.shortdesc: Reset your password from the Log in form if you use email and password authentication.

body.p: This applies only if you signed up using email and password.

In case you do not remember your password anymore, you can reset it. To reset your password, use the Forgot your password link in the Log in form. You are directed to a page where you can enter your email address and you will receive an email with instructions to reset your password.The Forgot your password link is displayed only if an email server is configured by the administrator.
